benchmark_name: CERT r4.2 SentinelAI-Q Shared Quantum ML Benchmark
purpose: Identical, reproducible evaluation for PennyLane QSVC and PennyLane VQC insider threat detection
classical_baseline_preservation_note: The full original preprocessed partitions (train.csv: 227,954 rows; validation.csv: 55,302 rows; test.csv: 47,196 rows) remain untouched at data/processed/cert_r4_2/ for classical baseline evaluation (XGBoost, Random Forest, Isolation Forest). The quantum benchmark cohorts represent bounded, balanced subsets designed for computationally viable statevector simulation.

class_balancing_documentation.rationale: Quantum statevector simulation of kernel matrices in QSVC scales O(N^2) in samples, and VQC parameter optimization scales linearly in batch evaluations. Simulating 330k samples is computationally intractable on quantum simulators. Class-balanced cohorts ensure meaningful decision boundary learning and standard quantum metric comparisons (Balanced Accuracy, AUC-ROC, F1-score) without minority class vanishing.
class_balancing_documentation.distinction_from_natural_prevalence: In natural-prevalence evaluation, positive incidence is 0.2923% (~1 positive per 341 benign days). Metrics measured on these quantum cohorts reflect discriminative capability under balanced/enriched settings. Deployment metrics under natural prevalence can be projected using Bayes theorem or evaluated via classical baselines on the full preserved validation/test partitions.
